metrics.native_billing.note: Native checkout or paid licensing availability; conditional programs require approval. Recheck current eligibility before launch.
metrics.eu_developer_access.note: Public developer route identified; personal Slovak onboarding and payout eligibility have not been tested.
metrics.free_apps_supported.note: Screening assumption from the public extension ecosystem; individual listing rules require review.
metrics.paid_apps_supported.note: Paid route is documented where native billing is verified; external checkout rules are not assumed.
metrics.ecosystem_maturity.note: Qualitative context, not a growth measurement.
metrics.activity.note: A reachable documentation page does not establish marketplace growth or commercial activity.
scores.saturation.note: Prior based on ecosystem focus and visible alternatives; no representative category counts or concentration study yet. Low score does not establish an underserved niche.
scores.distribution.note: Prior for in-marketplace discovery of a narrow utility; exposure is not a conversion measurement. Organic acquisition for new entrants remains unverified.
scores.willingness_to_pay.note: Prior from target customer and monetization route. Prices and business utility do not prove purchases.
scores.economics.note: Relative effort/monetization judgment for the stated small scope and fee scenario; not expected income or probability of success.
scores.demand.note: Customer-value prior, not observed customer demand for the proposed ideas.
scores.native_monetization.note: 10 for native paid checkout/licensing; 5 for selective monetization; 0 for external-only or free distribution; unknown when unverified.
